```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Assemble the canonical species table used by the spatial stages.
source("R/project_utils.R")
source("R/species_table_config.R")
source("R/figure_utils.R")

WRITE_OUTPUT <- isTRUE(params$write_output)
USE_GOMPERTZ_MAMMALS <- isTRUE(params$gompertz_mammals)
USE_GOMPERTZ_BIRDS <- isTRUE(params$gompertz_birds)
IUCN_PAUSE_SECONDS <- as.numeric(params$iucn_pause_seconds)
CURVES <- species_table_curves()
PATHS <- list(
  raw = list(
    summary = params$raw_summary,
    synonyms = params$raw_synonyms,
    mammal_traits = params$raw_mammal_traits,
    bird_traits = params$raw_bird_traits,
    random_effects = params$raw_random_effects
  ),
  rasters = tibble::tribble(
    ~taxon_class, ~sdm_method, ~dir_path,
    "Mammalia", "PPM", params$mammal_ppm_dir,
    "Mammalia", "RangeBag", params$mammal_rangebag_dir,
    "Aves", "PPM", params$bird_ppm_dir,
    "Aves", "RangeBag", params$bird_rangebag_dir
  ),
  clean = list(
    gompertz_models = params$gompertz_models,
    species_table = params$species_table
  )
)

load_species_table_packages()
source("R/species_table_inputs.R")
source("R/species_table_traits.R")
source("R/species_table_iucn.R")
source("R/species_table_build.R")

validate_species_table_config(
  params = params,
  paths = PATHS,
  use_gompertz_mammals = USE_GOMPERTZ_MAMMALS,
  use_gompertz_birds = USE_GOMPERTZ_BIRDS,
  write_output = WRITE_OUTPUT,
  iucn_pause_seconds = IUCN_PAUSE_SECONDS
)
```

```{r build_species_table}
species_table <- build_species_table(
  paths = PATHS,
  curves = CURVES,
  use_gompertz_mammals = USE_GOMPERTZ_MAMMALS,
  use_gompertz_birds = USE_GOMPERTZ_BIRDS,
  iucn_pause_seconds = IUCN_PAUSE_SECONDS
)

if (WRITE_OUTPUT) {
  readr::write_csv(species_table, PATHS$clean$species_table)
  message("Wrote: ", PATHS$clean$species_table)
}

class_counts <- species_table |>
  dplyr::count(className, name = "n")

message(
  "Species table complete | rows=", nrow(species_table),
  " | ", paste(paste0(class_counts$className, "=", class_counts$n), collapse = ", ")
)
```

```{r fig_area_curve_focal_species, fig.width=6.4, fig.height=3.3}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(scales)
})

dat_out <- if (exists("species_table", inherits = FALSE)) {
  species_table
} else if (file.exists(PATHS$clean$species_table)) {
  readr::read_csv(PATHS$clean$species_table, show_col_types = FALSE, progress = FALSE)
} else {
  stop(
    "Could not find species_table data for the area-curve figure.\n",
    "Expected an in-memory species_table object or file: ", PATHS$clean$species_table,
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

theme_area_curve <- function(base_size = 11.5) {
  ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = base_size) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.margin  = ggplot2::margin(7, 18, 6, 12),
      axis.title   = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", colour = "grey10"),
      axis.text    = ggplot2::element_text(colour = "grey20"),
      axis.line    = ggplot2::element_line(linewidth = 0.45, colour = "grey20"),
      axis.ticks   = ggplot2::element_line(linewidth = 0.45, colour = "grey20"),
      panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_line(colour = "grey94", linewidth = 0.28),
      panel.grid.major.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor   = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      legend.position    = "none"
    )
}

sp_name <- stringr::str_squish(as.character(params$figure_focal_species))
curve_use <- "q50"

sp_row <- dat_out |>
  dplyr::filter(scientificName == sp_name) |>
  dplyr::slice(1)

if (nrow(sp_row) == 0) {
  stop(paste0("Species not found in species_table: ", sp_name), call. = FALSE)
}

dens  <- as.numeric(sp_row$density)
alpha <- as.numeric(sp_row[[paste0("alpha_", curve_use)]])
beta  <- as.numeric(sp_row[[paste0("beta_",  curve_use)]])
A0    <- as.numeric(sp_row$min_pop_size)

if (!is.finite(dens) || dens <= 0 || !is.finite(alpha) || alpha <= 0 ||
    !is.finite(beta) || beta <= 0 || !is.finite(A0) || A0 <= 0) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "The required persistence parameters are missing or invalid for ", sp_name, ".\n",
      "Check density, alpha_", curve_use, ", beta_", curve_use, ", and min_pop_size in species_table."
    ),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

c_eff <- alpha * dens^(-beta)

delta_star <- c_eff^(1 / beta)
delta_grid <- 10^seq(log10(delta_star / 80), log10(delta_star * 350), length.out = 1400)

A <- A0 + delta_grid

log_z <- log(c_eff) - beta * log(delta_grid)
z <- exp(log_z)

P <- exp(-z)

log_dP <- (-z) + log(c_eff) + log(beta) - (beta + 1) * log(delta_grid)
dP <- exp(log_dP)

df <- tibble::tibble(
  area_km2 = c(A0, A),
  P = c(0, P),
  dP = c(0, dP)
) |>
  dplyr::arrange(area_km2)

s_deriv <- max(df$dP[is.finite(df$dP)], na.rm = TRUE)
df <- df |>
  dplyr::mutate(dP_scaled = dP / s_deriv)

band_cut <- 0.35
band_df <- df |>
  dplyr::filter(dP_scaled >= band_cut)

x_band_lo <- min(band_df$area_km2, na.rm = TRUE)
x_band_hi <- max(band_df$area_km2, na.rm = TRUE)

x_sat <- df |>
  dplyr::filter(P >= 0.995) |>
  dplyr::summarise(x = min(area_km2, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  dplyr::pull(x)

if (!is.finite(x_sat)) x_sat <- max(df$area_km2, na.rm = TRUE)

x_min <- max(A0 * 0.85, x_band_lo / 1.35)
x_max <- max(x_sat * 1.18, x_band_hi * 1.12)

x_min <- min(x_min, A0 * 0.96)
x_max <- max(x_max, A0 * 1.04)

plot_df <- df |>
  dplyr::filter(area_km2 >= A0, area_km2 <= x_max)

interp_y <- function(x, y, xout) {
  stats::approx(x = x, y = y, xout = xout, rule = 2)$y
}

x_at_frac <- function(frac, xmin, xmax) {
  10^(log10(xmin) + frac * (log10(xmax) - log10(xmin)))
}

x_lab_p <- x_at_frac(0.96, x_min, x_max)
y_lab_p <- max(
  min(interp_y(plot_df$area_km2, plot_df$P, x_lab_p) - 0.070, 0.85),
  0.74
)

x_lab_d <- x_at_frac(0.66, x_min, x_max)
y_lab_d <- max(
  min(interp_y(plot_df$area_km2, plot_df$dP_scaled, x_lab_d) + 0.040, 0.78),
  0.15
)

x_lab_a0 <- A0 * 1.15
y_lab_a0 <- 0.1

col_p <- "#0072B2"
col_dp <- "grey35"
col_A0 <- "grey40"
fill_band <- "grey80"

lwd_p <- 1.20
lwd_dp <- 0.88
lty_dp <- "22"
lwd_A0 <- 0.60
lty_A0 <- "dotted"

a0_in_view <- is.finite(A0) && A0 >= x_min && A0 <= x_max

area_curve_figure <- ggplot2::ggplot(plot_df, ggplot2::aes(x = area_km2)) +
  ggplot2::annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = x_band_lo,
    xmax = x_band_hi,
    ymin = 0,
    ymax = 1,
    fill = fill_band,
    alpha = 0.12
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(
    xintercept = A0,
    linewidth  = lwd_A0,
    linetype   = lty_A0,
    colour     = col_A0
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(
    ggplot2::aes(y = P),
    linewidth = lwd_p,
    lineend   = "round",
    colour    = col_p,
    na.rm     = TRUE
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(
    ggplot2::aes(y = dP_scaled),
    linewidth = lwd_dp,
    linetype  = lty_dp,
    lineend   = "round",
    colour    = col_dp,
    na.rm     = TRUE
  ) +
  ggplot2::annotate(
    "label",
    x = x_lab_p,
    y = y_lab_p,
    label = "Persistence probability",
    hjust = 1,
    size = 3.15,
    label.padding = grid::unit(0.10, "lines"),
    linewidth = 0,
    fill = scales::alpha("white", 0.88),
    colour = col_p
  ) +
  ggplot2::annotate(
    "label",
    x = x_lab_d,
    y = y_lab_d,
    label = "Marginal sensitivity (scaled)",
    hjust = 0,
    size = 3.10,
    label.padding = grid::unit(0.10, "lines"),
    linewidth = 0,
    fill = scales::alpha("white", 0.88),
    colour = "grey20"
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_log10(
    limits = c(x_min, x_max),
    breaks = scales::breaks_log(n = 4),
    labels = scales::label_comma(),
    expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.03))
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2),
    labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.1),
    expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0, 0.01))
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = expression("Habitat area, " * A * " (km"^2*")"),
    y = "Persistence probability"
  ) +
  ggplot2::coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_area_curve(base_size = 11.5)

if (isTRUE(a0_in_view)) {
  area_curve_figure <- area_curve_figure +
    ggplot2::annotate(
      "label",
      x = x_lab_a0,
      y = y_lab_a0,
      label = "A[0*','*s]",
      parse = TRUE,
      angle = 90,
      size = 3.0,
      label.padding = grid::unit(0.05, "lines"),
      linewidth = 0,
      fill = scales::alpha("white", 0.96),
      colour = "grey15"
    )
}

save_manuscript_figure(area_curve_figure, "area_curve")
area_curve_figure
```
